combinations.name: Hone the edge
combinations.text: You spit on the whetstone and work the knife in small circles until the edge catches the light.

combinations.name: Hone the edge
combinations.text: Long, even strokes on the river stone. The Guild shortsword comes up bright and keen.

combinations.name: Hone the edge
combinations.text: The falchion's broad edge takes a while, but it comes up keen.

combinations.name: Coat with venom
combinations.text: Gloves on. You split the gland and smear the grey venom along the edge. It smells like a fogbank and a dead fish.

combinations.name: Steep with yarrow

check.failureText: The yarrow goes brown and bitter in the vial before it steeps. That bundle is wasted; the tonic is fine.

combinations.text: You crush the yarrow in the satchel's mortar and let it steep in the tonic until it turns a clean, sharp green.
